title: Wall Street ends higher on cool inflation data, solid bank earnings
title_zh: 通胀数据温和、银行盈利稳健，华尔街收高
summary: STORY: U.S. stocks closed mostly higher on Tuesday, with the Dow ending little changed, the S&P 500 adding almost four-tenths of a percent and the Nasdaq gaining nine-tenths of a percent.Second-quarter earnings season began with five big U.S.
summary_zh: 故事：美国股市周二收盘大多走高，道琼斯指数收盘变化不大，标准普尔 500 指数上涨近十分之四，纳斯达克指数上涨十分之九。美国五大股指第二季度财报季拉开帷幕。

title: New York enacts statewide moratorium on AI data center construction: A closer look
title_zh: 纽约颁布全州暂停人工智能数据中心建设：仔细观察
summary: New York Governor Kathy Hochul signed an executive order to place a moratorium on the construction of new AI data centers. Yahoo Finance Technology Editor Dan Howley explains the details.
summary_zh: 纽约州州长 Kathy Hochul 签署了一项行政命令，暂停建设新的人工智能数据中心。雅虎财经技术编辑 Dan Howley 解释了细节。

title: Chinese AI model developer DeepSeek preps for IPO: What to know
title_zh: 中国人工智能模型开发商 DeepSeek 为 IPO 做准备：需要了解什么
summary: Chinese large language model (LLM) developer DeepSeek is reportedly preparing for an IPO later this year or in 2027. Yahoo Finance Technology Editor Dan Howley outlines what we know so far.
summary_zh: 据报道，中国大语言模型 (LLM) 开发商 DeepSeek 正准备在今年晚些时候或 2027 年进行 IPO。雅虎财经技术编辑丹·豪利 (Dan Howley) 概述了我们目前所知的情况。

title: OpenAI’s First Device Will Be Movable, Screenless Speaker Built as AI Companion
title_zh: OpenAI 的首款设备将是可移动、无屏幕扬声器，作为人工智能伴侣
summary: (Bloomberg) -- OpenAI’s much-anticipated push into consumer devices is slated to begin with a mobile, screen-free smart speaker designed to be a new type of home computer for the AI era, according to people familiar with the matter.Most Read from BloombergUS Hits Iran With Str...
summary_zh: (彭博社)——据知情人士透露，备受期待的 OpenAI 进军消费设备领域的计划将从一款移动、无屏幕智能音箱开始，该音箱旨在成为人工智能时代的新型家用电脑。

title: Why Meta stock suddenly broke out after a long slide
title_zh: 为什么Meta股票在长期下滑后突然爆发
summary: Meta stock is back in rally mode, for now.
summary_zh: 目前，Meta 股票又回到反弹模式。

title: June CPI report tests Fed rate cut outlook as Kevin Warsh testifies

summary: Yahoo Finance's Markets and Data Editor Jared Blikre and Senior Business Reporter Brooke DiPalma join Julie Hyman on Market Catalysts to break down the June Consumer Price Index (CPI) report, what it means for the Federal Reserve's rate-cut outlook, and how Fed Chair Kevin War...
summary_zh: 雅虎财经的市场和数据编辑贾里德·布利克尔 (Jared Blikre) 和高级商业记者布鲁克·迪帕尔玛 (Brooke DiPalma) 与朱莉·海曼 (Julie Hyman) 一起在市场催化剂上详细分析了 6 月份消费者价格指数 (CPI) 报告、这对美联储降息前景意味...

title: IBM stock closes down more than 25% after preannounced earnings results
title_zh: IBM 公布财报后股价收盘下跌逾 25%
summary: IBM stock collapsed 25% after the company preannounced its Q2 earnings results.
summary_zh: IBM 预先公布第二季度盈利结果后，该公司股价暴跌 25%。

title: Meta expands Louisiana data center to 5GW in new AI push
title_zh: Meta 在新的人工智能推动下将路易斯安那州数据中心扩展至 5GW
summary: Meta Platforms (META) will be expanding its data center project in Louisiana to 5 gigawatts of compute capacity. Yahoo Finance Tech Editor Dan Howley examines this latest news.
summary_zh: Meta Platforms (META) 将把其位于路易斯安那州的数据中心项目的计算能力扩展到 5 吉瓦。雅虎财经技术编辑丹·豪利 (Dan Howley) 审视了这一最新消息。

title: Is Meta's recent rally sustainable?
summary: Meta Platforms (META) stock has finally crossed back above its 200-day moving average, consecutively in its last two sessions.
summary_zh: Meta Platforms (META) 股票终于在过去两个交易日连续回穿 200 日移动均线上方。
